ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity, repurchasing 30,000 equity shares on October 5, 2026, at an average price of ₹274.96. This transaction brings the cumulative shares bought back under the program to 1,743,324. The buyback aims to reduce the number of outstanding shares, potentially boosting earnings per share, and this routine disclosure indicates no immediate red flags.
